svg.text: Laser board, sheet 1 of 4: supply, enable and lid
Draft for drawing in Fusion. Blue names are nets: the same name on any sheet is the same net.
Enable (one line for all six channels) and lid interlock
high = every set point clamped to zero
to the gates of Q101 ... Q601
TP3, TP4: ground loops for a scope or meter clip.
R8 + Q1: the ESP32 can only pull LASER_OFF low through Q1 and the
closed lid switch. Unpowered or in reset, Q1 is off and R7 holds
